items.title: fix(iOS): prevent unnecessary `TabContentsView` reloads affecting `TextInput` focus
items.description:
## Problem
Text input fields in tabbed pages were losing focus due to unnecessary collection view reloads in `TabContentsView`. See more here #117. 

## Solution
Added reload pattern similar to GalleryView/PagerBlock:
- Only do full `collectionView.reloadData()` when page count changes
- Use `configureVisibleCells()` when page count is same to preserve text input focus

items.title: fix(iOS): prevent unnecessary TabContentsView reloads affecting text input focus
items.description:
## Problem
Text input fields in tabbed pages were losing focus due to unnecessary collection view reloads in `TabContentsView`. See more here #117. 

## Solution
Removed the `oldModel.pages !== model.pages` comparison from the condition that triggers collection view reload and re-registration.

This comparison was causing the collection view to reload even when only the model reference changed but the actual page content remained the same or when only TextInputBlock's `isFocusing` variable was changed, leading to loss of text input focus and input content.

items.title: Issue #85: [Android] Implement Android extension for DivInput to show date and time picker
items.description:
### Implementation details
Basically adds click listener which opens DialogFragment with DatePickerDialog, TimePickerDialog or both depending on parameters.

Because input element based on EditText, applying this extension will make input non-focusable to prevent showing keyboard.
Since project doesn't use Java 8 or java.time backports, implementation was written using Date and Calendar objects.

### Tests
Implemented test cases for parsing and integration with DivKit containers. Also implemented test scenario for DivKit demo.
Picker fragment hasn't covered by tests.

### Future considerations
Currently, there's no special type for date and time or any parameters for date formatting. However, it would be nice to have these in the future.

Also, this implementation doesn't set previously set date as initial to DateTimePicker because it seems there's no way to read variable from code (https://t.me/divkit_community_ru/5890), while reading it from View state looks incorrect from design point.

items.title: fix(flutter): fix gradients in templates breaks rendering
Fix Keyboard Type Handling by Adding Input Formatter for Number Input in Flutter DivKit
items.description:
In the web playground, when the keyboard_type is set to number in JSON, the client-side ensures that users can only input and paste numeric values. However, in the Flutter DivKit, setting the keyboard_type to number only displays the numeric keyboard, but users can still paste or type non-numeric strings. This behavior is inconsistent with the web version, where non-numeric inputs are restricted.

**Changes Introduced:**

- Added an inputFormatter to DivInput in Flutter DivKit.
- The inputFormatter is set to digitsOnly when keyboard_type is number, ensuring users can only input numeric values.
- For all other keyboard_type values, the inputFormatter is set to none, allowing normal string input.

**Impact:**

- Ensures consistency between the web and Flutter versions regarding input behavior for numeric fields.
- Prevents users from inputting or pasting non-numeric values when keyboard_type is number in Flutter DivKit.

**Testing:**

- Verified that when keyboard_type is set to number, users can only input numeric values.
- Confirmed that for other keyboard_type values, normal string input is allowed.

items.title: Added nested ternary operator test case
items.description:
There are not enough examples of a nested operator, because when using nested operators, you need to implicitly add parentheses. Otherwise, the ternary operator in the expression is interpreted as an infix:

```JSON
"expression": "@{stringVariable == 'first' ? 1 : stringVariable == 'second' ? 2 : stringVariable == 'third' && intVariable < 42 ? 3 : 4}"
```

Causes an error:

```
ExpressionError(error.makeOutputMessage(for: expression), expression: link.rawValue)
(DivKit.ExpressionError) {
  message = "Undefined infix operator ?"
  ...
}
```

Therefore, the proposed pull request contains an additional example of a test case with nested ternary operators.

items.title: Request to make build Android client on Windows possible
items.description:
Spent few hours trying to build divkit/client/android on my Windows 11 machine. Finally made demo app run. Is windows support not considered or I misunderstood something?

This PR is not necessarily the best way to go (it's just enough to make it run), maybe use it as a starting point?

Encountered problems:
* Shell script `api_generator.sh` (won't run via WSL/bash.exe as well)
* Windows specific is to have backslash as separator in a path, which breaks strings in generated BuildConfig.
* Python tried to use cp1251 encoding by default.
